{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Compute conversion rate by segment using the full population (all orders)
# 'converted' is 1 for completed, 0 for refunded — so mean gives conversion rate
conversion_by_segment = df.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean() * 100

# Find the segment with the highest conversion rate
highest_segment = conversion_by_segment.idxmax()

# Print the full conversion rates
conversion_by_segment.sort_values(ascending=False)"}
